limits: Local Docker PostgreSQL on a shared, loaded macOS host; HTTP through the composed router in process (no TLS to the client, no browser, no network); the replay is the APP-195 client's timing, not a browser. Each page plays both the work page's document read and the canvas board's batch and view reads at once. The test profile is unoptimized; the service image is a release build.

runs.run: gate A: 15 pages, jitter 0-3 s, one retry, admitted 32
gate C: 15 pages at one instant, no retry, admitted 8 per role (before APP-195)
A: 26 pages, jitter 0-3 s, one retry, admitted 32
B: 26 pages at one instant, no jitter, no retry, admitted 32
C: run B with admitted 8 per role (before APP-195)

setup.lists: items: one shared row the owner changes; entries: a second shared list (no per-person list on this branch), 8 entries
setup.share: Workspace::share_work per member with record_write (25 shares); no organization-wide share on this branch
